title: Iguazú Falls
subtitle: NATURE IN ITS PUREST FORM
description: An unforgettable experience among walkways, rainforest and enormous waterfalls. We take you to Iguazú National Park to discover one of the world's natural wonders.

title: Puerto Iguazú International Airport (IGR)
subtitle: WORRY-FREE AIRPORT TRANSFERS
description: Travel to or from Cataratas del Iguazú International Airport (IGR) with a comfortable, punctual private transfer. We take you to your hotel, accommodation or tourist destination in Puerto Iguazú and coordinate arrival and departure times.

title: Three Borders Landmark
subtitle: WHERE THREE CULTURES MEET
description: Admire the meeting of the Iguazú and Paraná rivers, with views of Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay. An ideal outing to enjoy the scenery and sunset.

title: Güirá Oga Wildlife Refuge
subtitle: WILDLIFE OF MISIONES
description: Learn about the rescue and rehabilitation of wild animals in a rainforest setting. A visit to discover the region's biodiversity.

title: La Aripuca
subtitle: STORIES OF THE RAINFOREST
description: Discover a monumental structure built from large tree trunks and explore cultural experiences connected to nature and regional traditions.

title: Iguazú National Park — Argentina
subtitle: EXPLORE THE RAINFOREST
description: Walk along trails surrounded by lush vegetation, discover native wildlife and enjoy unique scenery in one of Argentina's most emblematic natural areas.

title: Downtown Puerto Iguazú
subtitle: THE CITY'S CHARM
description: Enjoy restaurants, cafés, shops and regional products in downtown Puerto Iguazú. An easy option for dinner or a worry-free stroll.

title: Wanda Mines
subtitle: TREASURES UNDERGROUND
description: Explore semi-precious stone deposits, mineral formations and sites that reveal the geological richness of Misiones.

title: Moconá Falls
subtitle: A UNIQUE WATERFALL IN THE WORLD
description: Discover the impressive Moconá Falls, where water cascades lengthwise along the Uruguay River, surrounded by rainforest and unique scenery. An excursion to explore another natural wonder of Misiones.

title: Puerto Iguazú Duty Free Shop
subtitle: BRANDS AND SHOPPING EXPERIENCES
description: Explore a wide range of international products, perfumes, cosmetics, beverages and brands in a shopping space that complements your visit to the Triple Frontier.

title: Madero Tango Iguazú
subtitle: MUSIC, DANCE AND SHOW
description: Enjoy entertainment inspired by Argentina's tango tradition, with music, dance and a night-time experience to add culture to your stay in Puerto Iguazú.

title: IceBar Iguazú
subtitle: FUN BELOW ZERO
description: Try something different at an ice bar surrounded by ice sculptures and frozen settings. A unique option for couples, friends or families.

title: Fly Park Iguazú
subtitle: FUN AMONG THE TREES
description: Enjoy an outdoor adventure with courses and challenges in a natural setting. A great alternative for anyone looking for something different in Iguazú.

title: Mbocay Stream
subtitle: A NATURAL CORNER OF IGUAZÚ
description: Discover a natural setting of streams and vegetation in Puerto Iguazú. An option for exploring quieter spots and enjoying the Misiones rainforest.

title: Ecological horseback riding
subtitle: EXPLORE THE RAINFOREST ON HORSEBACK
description: Ride along natural trails and connect with the region's vegetation and scenery in a different way. An experience combining tourism, adventure and nature.

title: Iguazú Catamaran
subtitle: UNFORGETTABLE SCENERY AND SUNSETS
description: Take a boat trip to admire the Triple Frontier from the water. A relaxing experience offering a different perspective of the rivers and their surroundings.

title: San Ignacio Miní Ruins
subtitle: A JOURNEY INTO MISIONES' PAST
description: Explore the historic Jesuit ruins of San Ignacio Miní and discover the legacy of the missions, their stone architecture and Guaraní history. A cultural excursion through Misiones' heritage.

title: Iguazú Falls — Brazilian side
subtitle: THE PANORAMA OF THE FALLS
description: Admire a stunning panoramic view of the waterfalls from Brazil and capture unforgettable photos. We take you to Foz do Iguaçu to experience another side of the Falls.

title: Parque das Aves
subtitle: COLORS OF NATURE
description: Walk through immersive aviaries and discover Atlantic Forest birds on an educational trail surrounded by tropical vegetation.

title: Three Borders Landmark
subtitle: BRAZILIAN HISTORY AND CULTURE
description: Enjoy views of the rivers and neighboring countries, along with cultural experiences and performances celebrating the identity of the Triple Frontier.

title: Itaipu Dam
subtitle: AN EXTRAORDINARY ACHIEVEMENT
description: Discover one of the world's largest hydroelectric plants through the tours and visitor experiences available at the Itaipu complex.

title: Chen Tien Buddhist Temple
subtitle: A PLACE OF TRANQUILITY
description: Stroll through the gardens and admire Buddhist sculptures in a peaceful setting with city views. A different cultural outing in Foz do Iguaçu.

title: Omar Ibn Al-Khattab Mosque
subtitle: CULTURAL DIVERSITY
description: Discover a landmark of Foz do Iguaçu's Muslim community and appreciate its architecture. Check visiting hours and conditions before you go.

title: Yup Star Foz
subtitle: THE CITY FROM ABOVE
description: Ride the Ferris wheel for panoramic views of Foz do Iguaçu and its surroundings. An ideal outing for couples, families and photography lovers.

title: Helicopter ride over the Falls
subtitle: IGUAZÚ FROM THE AIR
description: See Iguazú Falls from an extraordinary perspective. An aerial ride to admire the scale of the waterfalls, rainforest and regional scenery from above.

title: Dreamland Wax Museum
subtitle: PHOTOS AND FUN FOR EVERYONE
description: Explore an exhibition of wax figures inspired by celebrities, historical figures and entertainment icons. A fun activity for the whole family.

title: Rafain Churrascaria Show
subtitle: BRAZILIAN FLAVORS AND AN INTERNATIONAL SHOW
description: Enjoy a dining experience featuring traditional Brazilian barbecue and a show of Latin American music and dance. An evening of food and entertainment in Foz do Iguaçu.

title: Movie Cars Entertainment
subtitle: ICONIC CARS AND FILM SETS
description: Explore a themed attraction featuring iconic vehicles from film and popular culture in photo-ready settings. A memorable experience for movie and car fans.

title: Foz do Iguaçu Water Park
subtitle: WATER, GAMES AND ADVENTURE
description: Add fun to your trip with pools, slides and recreational activities at a water park in Foz do Iguaçu. A refreshing way to enjoy a different day on holiday.

title: Monday Falls
subtitle: NATURE IN ITS PUREST POWER
description: Discover impressive waterfalls surrounded by vegetation in Presidente Franco. An ideal outing to connect with nature and explore another regional attraction.

title: Shopping in Ciudad del Este
subtitle: SHOPPING ACROSS THE BORDER
description: Explore shopping centers, technology stores, perfumeries and a huge variety of products in one of South America's best-known shopping hubs.

title: Lake of the Republic
subtitle: A BREAK IN THE CITY
description: Enjoy a green space beside the lake, ideal for walking, resting and taking a peaceful break during your visit to Ciudad del Este.
